Handikaplı turlarda her oyuncu kendi han: In handicap rounds every player plays to his own handicap points. In elimination, the order number sets the seeding (1 = strongest).

Tur sayısı için önce en az iki katılımcı: Add at least two participants first to know the number of rounds.

Örnek: 10 turluk turnuvada 8 yazıp sabit: Example: in a 10-round tournament enter 8 and a fixed target of 40 → the first 8 rounds are handicap, the last 2 are played to 40.
